summary: 89 items audited. The category is heavily skewed toward a few well-developed families (cream-of soups, tomato sauces, fruit preserves, broths/stocks, juice concentrates, mincemeat, cranberry sauce, applesauce) and is thin or absent on the genuinely canned-only staples a recipe app needs most: canned tomatoes in their canonical forms (whole/crushed/diced/passata), canned coconut milk is present but canned beans/fish/olives/peppers are deliberately NOT here because the catalog's convention puts the canonical product elsewhere (beans+chickpeas in 'Legumes & Beans' with a Pantry [365,1095] canned shelf-life baked in; tuna/sardines/anchovies/salmon/clams in 'Protein'; olives/artichoke/corn/jackfruit/water-chestnut/beet/pimento in 'Produce'; capers/tapenade/relish/anchovy-paste/black-bean-sauce in 'Condiments & Sauces'; evaporated milk in 'Dairy & Eggs'). I respected that convention and did NOT duplicate fresh equivalents; instead I propose canned-only products that have no canonical home (canned tomatoes by cut, tomato puree/passata, condensed soups, enchilada/adobo sauces, jarred peppers/pickled goods, condensed/evaporated specifics, jackfruit-in-brine, water chestnuts). Several existing items have mis-routed aliases ('cream of X soup' attached to broths, 'passata' attached to an item literally named 'fire roasted'), facet-fragment names that are not human-readable on their own ('puree', 'bavarian', 'fire roasted', 'jellied', 'no beans', 'with rum'), and storage/freshness inconsistencies between an item and its 'organic' twin.
issues: MIS-ROUTED ALIAS: 'fire-roasted' (display name literally 'fire roasted', parent tomato-sauce) carries aliases ['passata','salsa di pomodoro']. Passata is strained/sieved uncooked tomato puree, a distinct product from a fire-roasted tomato sauce. These aliases should move to a proper 'tomato passata' item (proposed below); 'fire-roasted' should be 'fire roasted tomatoes' or 'fire roasted tomato sauce'.

MIS-ROUTED ALIAS: 'chicken-broth' (parent broth+chicken) carries aliases ['chicken soup','cream of chicken soup']. Cream-of-chicken is a condensed cream soup, not a broth; the alias belongs on a cream-soup child, not on stock.
MIS-ROUTED ALIAS: 'mushroom-broth' (parent broth) carries aliases ['cream of mushroom soup','mushroom soup']. Cream of mushroom is a cream soup, not a broth.
MIS-ROUTED ALIAS: 'vegetable' (vegetable broth, parent broth) carries alias 'cream of vegetable soup' — again a cream soup, not a broth.
MIS-ROUTED ALIAS: 'tomato-soup' carries 'cream of tomato soup' but has no link to the cream-soup family; and 'cheese-cream-soup' vs 'cheddar-cream-soup' overlap (see redundancies).

WRONG-FRUIT FACET: 'apple-juice-concentrate' has facet color option 'orange' and facetAliases mapping 'orange juice concentrate'/'orange' onto it. Orange juice concentrate is a different fruit and should not be an alias of apple juice concentrate.

NON-HUMAN-READABLE NAMES (facet-fragment stubs): 'fire-roasted'(=fire roasted), 'italian-herb'(=italian herb), 'no-salt-added'(=no salt added), 'puree'(=purée), 'bavarian'(=bavarian sauerkraut OK-ish), 'jellied'(=jellied cranberry sauce), 'whole-berry', 'stemless', 'with-stems', 'no-beans', 'with-beans', 'with-rum', 'with-brandy', 'no-suet', 'pie-mix', 'vegetable'(=vegetable broth), 'mixed-berry'. Many read as bare adjectives without their parent noun; display names should include the product (e.g. 'no salt added tomato sauce').

AMBIGUOUS BARE ITEM: 'puree' (display 'purée') has no parent and an unclear referent — tomato? fruit? It overlaps with 'tomato-paste'/'pumpkin-puree' and should either be removed or specified as 'tomato puree'.

STORAGE INCONSISTENCY: 'sauerkraut' defaultStorage=Refrigerated (correct for refrigerated/fresh kraut) but its child 'sauerkraut-organic' defaultStorage=Pantry with Pantry [365,1095]; 'bavarian'/'wine-sauerkraut' are Refrigerated. A canned/jarred shelf-stable kraut and a refrigerated fresh kraut are different products being conflated under one node.

STORAGE/FRESHNESS INCONSISTENCY between base and 'organic' twins: e.g. 'applesauce' Pantry [180,365] vs 'applesauce-organic' Pantry [365,1095]; 'coconut-cream'/'coconut-milk' Frozen [60,180] vs their organic twins Frozen [90,180]. 'Organic' should not change shelf life; pick one freshness profile per product.

OPENED-FRESHNESS LIKELY WRONG for brined/oil-packed jarred goods: tomato products correctly drop to Refrigerated [3,7] once opened, but jarred items in brine/oil (olives, pickles, peppers, capers, maraschino) keep 1-2 months refrigerated. 'pickle'/'maraschino-cherry' use Refrigerated [30,90] (good); any new jarred-in-brine item should follow that, not [3,7].

REDUNDANT ORGANIC SUBTREE: the catalog encodes 'organic' as a separate child item for many products (applesauce-organic, broth-organic, coconut-cream-organic, coconut-milk-organic, cranberry-sauce-organic, pumpkin-puree-organic, sauerkraut-organic, tomato-paste-organic, tomato-sauce-organic). 'Organic' is a sourcing facet, not a distinct ingredient; this inflates the category and creates the freshness mismatches above. Consider collapsing to a facet rather than child items (noted, not auto-fixing).

GAP — canned tomatoes: there is NO canned whole/crushed/diced/stewed tomato item and no tomato puree/passata. 'tomato-sauce','tomato-paste','fire-roasted' exist but the workhorse 'a can of chopped tomatoes' (the single most-used canned ingredient in savory recipes) is missing. Fresh 'tomato' (Produce) does not substitute in recipes that call for canned.

GAP — condensed milk family incomplete: 'sweetened-condensed-milk' exists; evaporated milk lives in Dairy & Eggs (acceptable), but there is no 'dulce de leche' and no plain 'condensed milk' disambiguation.

GAP — chiles/peppers: only 'canned-green-chile' exists. No chipotle-in-adobo, no canned/jarred jalapeños (pickled), no roasted red peppers (jarred), no pimientos jar form, no enchilada/red chile sauce.
GAP — jarred antipasti: no jarred artichoke hearts (Produce 'artichoke' has no Pantry/canned profile), no marinated/jarred peppers, no sun-dried tomatoes in oil, no giardiniera, no pepperoncini.

GAP — global/Asian canned staples: no canned water chestnuts (Produce item exists but as fresh-style, Pantry [365,1095] is actually fine), no bamboo shoots canned, no canned young/green jackfruit in brine for the canned aisle (Produce 'canned-young' jackfruit exists but is filed under Produce with Refrigerated default — odd for a canned product), no canned coconut milk light/full variants beyond what exists.
GAP — soups beyond cream-of and tomato: no canned minestrone/lentil/vegetable/chicken-noodle ready soup, no canned bisque, no broth concentrate/bouillon paste (bouillon may live in Spices).

GAP — pie/dessert: 'cherry/lemon/pumpkin' pie fillings exist but no apple pie filling and no canned cherry/blueberry pie filling for the common ones — apple is conspicuously missing given applesauce is well-covered.
redundancies: 'cheese cream soup' (aliased 'cream of cheddar cheese soup') and 'cheddar cream soup' are the same product; cheddar is the cheese. Merge into one (keep 'cheddar-cream-soup', fold cheese aliases in).

Both carry identical aliases ['canned fruit cocktail','fruit cocktails','mixed fruit']; tropical is a flavor variant of the same canned fruit cocktail. Keep parent 'fruit-cocktail', make tropical a true child without duplicate aliases.

'organic' is a sourcing facet, not a distinct ingredient; identical aliases ['canned coconut milk','coconut milks']. Same applies to every '-organic' twin (applesauce/broth/coconut-cream/cranberry-sauce/pumpkin-puree/sauerkraut/tomato-paste/tomato-sauce).
Duplicate aliases ['canned tomato paste','tomato pastes']; organic adds no ingredient distinction.
Bare 'puree' (purée) with no parent overlaps ambiguously with tomato-paste / pumpkin-puree; if it means tomato puree it duplicates the proposed canned-tomato-puree, if generic it should be removed.

'chicken-broth' and 'chicken-stock' both exist with chicken-stock as a thin child of broth; broth vs stock is a near-synonym distinction most recipes treat as 1:1. Consider merging (keep one, alias the other) — also true of beef-broth/'beef stock', vegetable/'vegetable-stock'.

'fire-roasted' is a flavor variant child of tomato-sauce but its name and the 'passata' alias make it read as a standalone tomato product; the passata alias is the real redundancy/mis-route (passata is not fire-roasted).

newItems.name: canned diced tomatoes
newItems.notes: The single most-used canned ingredient in savory cooking and currently absent. Unopened 18-24mo peak / indefinite if undamaged; opened 5-7 days refrigerated (StillTasty/USDA).

newItems.name: canned whole peeled tomatoes
newItems.notes: Whole peeled (often San Marzano) packed in juice/puree; the base for many sauces.

newItems.name: canned crushed tomatoes
newItems.notes: Distinct cut from diced/whole; thicker, partially broken down.

newItems.name: tomato puree
newItems.notes: Receives the 'passata' aliases currently mis-attached to 'fire-roasted'. Smooth strained uncooked tomato; thinner than paste, thicker than juice.

newItems.name: stewed tomatoes
newItems.notes: Diced tomatoes pre-seasoned with onion/celery/pepper; common American pantry staple.

newItems.name: diced tomatoes with green chiles
newItems.notes: Distinct branded staple (Rotel) widely called for in Tex-Mex/dip recipes.

newItems.name: chipotle peppers in adobo
newItems.notes: Unopened 3-5yr; opened keeps 1-2 months refrigerated (StillTasty), 6mo frozen. No canonical fresh equivalent.

newItems.name: jarred roasted red peppers
newItems.notes: Unopened jar 3-5yr peak; opened keeps ~1-2 months refrigerated in its brine/oil (StillTasty).

newItems.name: pickled jalapenos
newItems.notes: Pickled, brine-packed; distinct from fresh jalapeño (Produce). Opened keeps 1-3mo refrigerated like other pickled goods.

newItems.name: jarred artichoke hearts
newItems.notes: Fresh 'artichoke' lives in Produce with no Pantry profile; canned/jarred hearts are a distinct pantry product used in dips/salads/pizza.

newItems.name: sun-dried tomatoes in oil
newItems.notes: Oil-packed jarred form; opened keeps 1-2 months refrigerated submerged in oil.

newItems.name: canned coconut milk light
newItems.notes: Distinct from full-fat for recipe macros; common SKU. Child of existing coconut-milk.

newItems.name: dulce de leche
newItems.notes: Canned caramelized milk; contains dairy (not Vegan/Dairy-Free). Sibling of sweetened condensed milk.

newItems.name: enchilada sauce
newItems.notes: Canned chile-tomato sauce, distinct from generic tomato sauce; staple in Mexican recipes.

newItems.name: pumpkin pie mix
newItems.notes: Disambiguation child: spiced/sweetened pie MIX (contains dairy/eggs varies) vs plain pumpkin puree. Existing 'pie-mix' is mislabeled as pumpkin puree; this clarifies the sweetened mix is NOT interchangeable with puree.

newItems.name: apple pie filling
newItems.notes: Conspicuous gap: cherry/lemon/pumpkin fillings exist, apple (the most common) does not. May contain gluten thickeners so Gluten-Free omitted.

newItems.name: canned green chile enchilada base
newItems.notes: Southwestern staple sauce form; child of existing canned-green-chile.

newItems.name: canned baked beans in tomato sauce
newItems.notes: OPTIONAL / convention note: 'baked-beans' already exists in 'Legumes & Beans'. Include here ONLY if the app wants the British 'beans on toast' tin discoverable in the canned aisle; otherwise rely on the existing Legumes entry. Listed for completeness, flagged as likely redundant.

newItems.name: canned minestrone soup
newItems.notes: Ready-to-eat canned soups are absent (only cream-of and tomato exist). Represents the heat-and-serve soup aisle; many contain gluten pasta so Gluten-Free omitted.

cleanups.fix: Rename display to 'fire roasted tomatoes' (or 'fire roasted tomato sauce'); REMOVE aliases 'passata' and 'salsa di pomodoro' (move passata to the proposed tomato-puree item).
Remove aliases 'chicken soup' and 'cream of chicken soup' (these are a condensed cream soup, not stock); add a proper cream-of-chicken under cream-soup if desired.
Remove aliases 'cream of mushroom soup' and 'mushroom soup'; cream of mushroom is a cream soup, not broth.
Rename display to 'vegetable broth'; remove alias 'cream of vegetable soup'.
Remove the 'orange'/'orange juice concentrate' facetAliases and the color facet option 'orange' — wrong fruit.
Either rename to 'tomato puree' and parent under canned tomatoes, or remove as ambiguous (overlaps pumpkin-puree/tomato-paste).
Align defaultStorage with parent 'sauerkraut' (Refrigerated) OR split shelf-stable canned kraut from refrigerated fresh kraut; current Pantry [365,1095] vs parent Refrigerated is inconsistent.
Match freshness to parent 'applesauce' (Pantry [180,365]); 'organic' should not extend Pantry to [365,1095]. Same correction for all '-organic' twins.
Merge into 'cheddar-cream-soup' (same product); fold aliases ['cheddar cheese soup','cream of cheddar cheese soup'] into the survivor.
Make a true flavor child of 'fruit-cocktail' and drop the duplicated aliases ['canned fruit cocktail','fruit cocktails','mixed fruit'].

Rename display 'pie mix pumpkin puree' is confusing — it is sweetened/spiced pumpkin PIE MIX, NOT plain puree; rename to 'pumpkin pie mix' and stop implying it equals pumpkin-puree (they are not interchangeable).
Collapse into 'tomato-paste' (organic = facet); remove duplicate aliases.
Collapse into 'coconut-milk' (organic = facet); duplicate aliases ['canned coconut milk','coconut milks'].
Optionally add link to cream-soup family or keep standalone; alias 'cream of tomato soup' is fine but ensure it is not also the canonical for condensed tomato-cream-soup.
